newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bond confirms Hees ratings.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bond confirms Hees ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Friday it confirmed Hees International Bancorp Inc debt and preferred share ratings in light of its proposed merger with brother company Edper Group Ltd.

DBRS confirmed Hees' senior notes and debentures as well as its medium term notes at BBB with a positive trend. Hees subordinated notes and debentures were confirmed at BBB(low) with a positive trend while its preferred shares were affirmed at Pfd-3 with a stable trend.
The agency confirmed Hees commercial paper at R-2 (high) with a positive trend.

"The confirmation is based on the proposed amalgamation receiving the necessary support, with little change in the terms and conditions. The proposal continues the process of simplifying the corporate structure of the Edper-Hees group begun several years earlier," DBRS said.
The agency said the capital structure of the new company will be very similar to that of the original Hees since the Edper Group's main asset is simply an investment in Hees.
